title: With Friends Like These...
description: After killing Grelod the Kind, the Dark Brotherhood abducts you. Astrid demands you kill one of three captives to repay the debt of stealing their contract. Completing the test grants entry to the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary and membership in the Family.

base_facts: I am the leader of the Dark Brotherhood sanctuary near Falkreath.
By killing Grelod the Kind, you stole a contract belonging to the Night Mother.
You must repay your debt with a life for a life.

CAPTIVE_KILLED: The captive has been killed. I will give you the passphrase to the Sanctuary: Silence, my Brother.
JOINED_BROTHERHOOD: Welcome to the Family. You are now a full member of the Dark Brotherhood.
KILLED_ASTRID: I am dead, slain by the very person I abducted for the test.
My corpse carries the key to the Abandoned Shack door.
My death permanently bars the player from ever joining the Dark Brotherhood.
My murder has triggered the Destroy the Dark Brotherhood! quest against my sanctuary.

base_facts: I am a mercenary, a sell-sword by trade.
Maybe there were times I got carried away, but war is war.

KILLED_ASTRID: With Astrid dead, my bonds can be loosened and I can walk free from the shack.
I will remain tied up in the Abandoned Shack unless the player chooses to release me.

base_facts: I am a mother of six and I have had to be tough to survive.
Do some people look down on me? Have I made some enemies? You are damn right.

KILLED_ASTRID: Astrid's death means my captor is gone and I can finally be freed from this chair.
I remain bound and demanding release unless the player unties me.

base_facts: I am an obtainer of goods, taker of lives, and defiler of daughters.
This is not the first time I have been bagged and dragged.
If one of my enemies would not pay to have me killed, I would take it as a personal insult.

KILLED_ASTRID: Astrid's death is merely a change in circumstance; my bonds can now be undone.
I wait calmly in the shack, free to be released now that my captor lies dead.

beats.comment: Player wakes in the Abandoned Shack; Astrid explains the debt for stealing the Night Mother's contract.
Player kills one of the three captives; Astrid provides the passphrase to the Sanctuary.
Astrid gives the passphrase Silence my Brother; player must find and enter the Sanctuary.
Player has entered the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary and must speak with Astrid inside.
Quest complete; player is officially welcomed into the Dark Brotherhood and receives Shrouded Armor.
Player killed Astrid instead of a captive; can never join the Dark Brotherhood.
